name: Product Demo / Feedback Session
description: Capture structured notes from product demonstrations, vendor evaluations, and user feedback sessions including reactions, issues, and next steps.

sections.title: Session Overview
sections.instruction: Summarize the product or feature being demonstrated, the purpose of the session (vendor eval, internal review, user testing, etc.), and the intended outcome.

sections.title: Participants
sections.instruction: List the presenter(s), demonstrators, and audience members. Note roles such as vendor rep, product owner, evaluator, or end user.

sections.title: Features & Capabilities Demonstrated
sections.instruction: Summarize each feature, workflow, or capability shown during the demo. Capture how each was presented and any notable highlights or selling points.

sections.title: Strengths & Positives
sections.instruction: List the aspects of the product that received positive reactions, strong impressions, or aligned well with stated needs.

sections.title: Concerns, Gaps & Issues
sections.instruction: List concerns raised, missing features, usability issues, integration gaps, or anything that did not meet expectations.

sections.title: Questions & Answers
sections.instruction: Capture notable questions asked during or after the demo and the responses provided. Note any questions that were deferred or unanswered.

sections.title: Overall Impression & Recommendation
sections.instruction: Summarize the group's overall reaction to the product. Include any preliminary recommendation, scoring, or consensus reached (e.g., advance to next phase, decline, request follow-up).

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: List follow-up actions including additional demos, reference checks, proposals, pilots, or internal discussions needed. Include owners and timelines.
